cases.prompt: 根据 requirements.md 设计一个用户与权限管理 Pen 原型
expected: resolves markdown input and list-page guidance
runs library preflight before node creation
queries rather than loading the full registry
includes loading, empty, error, and permission states

cases.prompt: 把 existing-form.html 转成标准 Ant Design Pen 原型
expected: uses HTML as structural evidence instead of preserving arbitrary CSS
checks for a form template without forcing a mismatch

cases.prompt: 优化 rough.pen，保留已有流程并统一为当前组件库
根据需求目录中的 PRD 和参考 .pen 创建后台客群管理原型。必须用 antd-6.lib 的 AppShell 模板；所有完整页面固定 1920px 宽、至少 1080px 高，不制作窄屏或响应式状态，保存为原型.pen。
expected: creates every full page as a top-level ref to the catalogued Admin App Shell frame
places business content inside the shell's replaceable page body slot
keeps Menu, Breadcrumb, Header, and Sider as template descendants
configures component inputs from library Examples and Components scenarios
checks every delivered page at 1920px width and at least 1080px height, with no narrow-screen state or clipped content
saves, reopens, and verifies the persisted ref, import, position, size, and visual layout
